corpus: all 1,814,924 pinned ESCI locale-product records; each query searches its own locale
query: unchanged locale analyzers, NFKC and literal QueryBuilder SHOULD query; only locale filter, no candidate or judgment filter
ranking: descending Lucene float32 BM25 score, then ascending product_id using sorted doc values, including cutoff ties
empty_results: return no products for empty analysis or no lexical matches; never pad with nonmatching products
primary_metric: mean known_exact_recall_at_100: retrieved judged Exact products / all judged Exact products for the query
zero_exact_policy: per-query recall is null and excluded from recall mean/CI; report the excluded count; retain these queries for other metrics
secondary_metric: judgment_coverage_at_10: judged products / min(10, returned products); empty lists score 0 by explicit convention
coverage_safeguard: also report returned-at-10 counts, mean slot-fill fraction, empty and short-result counts; coverage is not precision
unjudged_policy: unknown relevance; never relabel as Irrelevant; do not publish full-catalog NDCG as a headline or drop unjudged results before computing ranks
aggregation: query-weighted overall and per locale; secondary equal-locale macro mean

confidence.method: percentile bootstrap of locale-normalized query groups, retaining member query IDs; exclude undefined recall observations only

hypothesis: establish measured title-BM25 known-Exact retrieval and judgment coverage for later dense/fusion comparisons; no gain or minimum performance is assumed
tuning: none; one fixed baseline; official test never opened; no model, spell, entity or bullet changes
parity: new index adds locale and product-ID sorting fields; require exact frozen judged-candidate score artifact before retrieval measurement
repeat: two independent full-catalog builds must reproduce query input, parity scores, retrieval/status and per-query metrics, aggregate metrics and confidence intervals
